gates.gate2_note: VRP_t uses VIX_t and past returns only; fwd realized var is tagged outcome

interpretation: V1 gates passed: the average implied-vs-realized premium is positive and persistent across IS and the modern OOS window (see mean_vrp_vol by era). This confirms the LEVEL of the variance risk premium is real. It does NOT establish a deployable edge: capturing it requires selling vol/options with real costs and the severe fat tail, which V1 does not model. Whether the premium is *harvestable* after costs and survives its own tail, and whether event/conditional versions add anything, is the V2 question.
